supraorbital_contour.lateral_prominence: Visible extension of the ridge boundary beyond the outer corners of the eyes.

macro_zonal_melanin_distribution.regional_intensity_contrast: High contrast between the light muzzle/chin area and the significantly darker (lower pixel intensity) cheek and periocular regions.

maxillary_and_labial_geometry.resting_lip_thickness: Moderate vertical thickness of the lower lip with a distinct light-colored protrusion on the viewer's left.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Small, bright-white circular anomaly visible on the lower lip margin.
other_distinctive_markers: Dense white/grey pilosity on the chin forming a distinct beard-like zone.
